result_text: Both tooltips now escape the repository name, so a name like `acme "shop"` shows as plain text on hover. The change is in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`: - **Language blocks** (`addLangInfo`, ~line 1076): each repository name is passed through `StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4` before the `(N LOC)` suffix is appended. - **Repositories Size Distribution** (~line 1333): the same escaping is applied to the repository name before the line count is appended. - Added the `org.apache.commons.text.StringEscapeUtils` import, which the module already uses elsewhere. Counts, LOC values, ordering and layout are unchanged. I did not change the shared `startDivWithLabel` helper, so other tooltips keep their current behaviour. `mvn -q -o -pl reports test` passes. I did not generate a landscape report or open it in a browser to check the hover text visually. Nothing is committed.
